ns2:course.label: Assessment in Early Childhood Special Education
ns2:course.description: Practice in designing and applying assessment devices and procedures and in using them to make educational decisions for children with special needs, birth through kindergarten age. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in SPED 524 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent registration in SPED 524 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Special Education or Early Childhood Education or Early Childhood Education major(s).
